narrative: Iran's proposed seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz eases immediate geopolitical supply fears, setting up an unwinding of energy premiums for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1395, where a +143bp OIS carry advantage favors USD and caps upside ahead of October policy meetings. Meanwhile, USD/JPY closed Friday at 157.28, likely to face downside pressure at Sunday's open if risk sentiment stabilizes across regional assets. Focus shifts immediately to Tuesday's RBA decision, the week's earliest high-impact policy catalyst.
